The Eastemnet was a part of Rohan, and an area of wide, grassy plains found east of the river Entwash, between it and the Great River Anduin. 

 Size: 450 x 450 
 Lairs: 4x Troll Lair, 4x Warg Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 2x Inn , 1x Signal Fire
Pinnath Gelin

Pinnath Gelin or Green Hills was a fief in the far west of Gondor, bounded to the west by the River Lefnui, and to the east by the Morthond. 

 Size: 400 x 460 
 Lairs: 2x Troll Lair, 4x Warg Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 2x Inn , 1x Signal Fire
Dor-en-Ernil

Though its boundaries are not clearly established, Dor-en-Ernil appears to have been part of - or perhaps synonymous with - the mountainous coastland fief known as Belfalas or the wider sense of Dol Amroth. 

 Size: 550 x 570 
 Lairs: 5x Troll Lair, 6x Warg Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 1x Inn
